    * @brief Retrieve metadata about the corrections.
    *
    * This function delegates the retrieval of correction metadata to the derived class
    * by calling its `getCorrectionsMetaDataImpl` method. The derived class must implement this
    * method.
    *
    * @return Metadata about the corrections, as defined by the `CorrectorTraits` of the derived
    * class.
    */
   typename CorrectorTraits<T_DERIVED>::CorrectionsMetaData getCorrectionsMetaData() const
   {
      return static_cast<const T_DERIVED*>(this)->getCorrectionsMetaDataImpl();
   }
